data.body: Landed: Gerrit 3300 merged as 1a23adaf04e5db1548ac8e0d0e3650414dc96339 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 on run 41824490749). Read-only SSM, 2026-11-04 04:25 PST: mcp-deployed-sha = 1a23adaf04e; container rebar-mcp-1a23adaf04e5-8092 carried REBAR_COMPACT_WORKER_LOG=stderr. At 04:36 PST a later deploy (fe6c2100292) had replaced it: the container is gone from docker ps -a, yet journalctl CONTAINER_NAME=rebar-mcp-1a23adaf04e5-8092 still returns its 69 lines through its 04:30 PST shutdown. AC3 NOT yet met: no compaction sweep ran in that container (0 'rebar._commands.compact' lines in journalctl -t rebar-mcp across all releases), so no sweep log has yet been shown to survive a deploy. Remaining check: after the first MCP close that fires a sweep and the following deploy, run journalctl -t rebar-mcp | grep rebar._commands.compact on the host. Ticket left in_progress; AC1/AC2 boxes left unticked until the close so the plan attestation stays current. Discovered: exemplary-silty-tuatara (trigger lock and sweep stamp are also on the writable layer).
